_frozen_rule: This file becomes immutable when it is referenced by a pre-registration (eval/README.md). Any later change, including to cause names, goes into catalog.v2.json.

causes.cpu_throttling: The model-server container is limited by its CFS CPU quota: throttled periods rise and inference slows down (and may time out).
causes.oom_killed: A container on the request path is killed by the kernel for exceeding its memory limit (terminated reason OOMKilled, exit code 137).
causes.unschedulable: The model-server pod cannot be placed on any node (FailedScheduling), so there is no serving endpoint.
causes.readiness_failing: The model-server pod runs but is not Ready, so the Service has no endpoint for it.
causes.cold_start: Requests fail or wait while a new model-server pod is still starting (image pull, model download or model load).
causes.config_change: A recent rollout of model-server changed its configuration and the change degrades serving, without any resource-pressure signal.
causes.unknown_no_infrastructure_cause: The request was slow or failed but no Kubernetes event, resource metric or configuration change in the cluster explains it.

_causes_note: Closed list. expected_causes[].cause in run.json must be one of these names. A no-fault window has expected_causes = [] (nothing abnormal to report).

repetitions._note: test: 10 fault variants x 2 = 20 injections; no-fault test: 3 variants x 7 = 21 windows

variants.mechanism: in-place resize of the running pod (kubectl patch --subresource resize --type strategic)
variants.signal: events ResizeStarted/ResizeCompleted; ~98% CFS periods throttled; latency x6-7; long-256 times out (502)

variants.mechanism: in-place resize of the running pod
variants.signal: expected: same as limit-300m, weaker

variants.mechanism: CPU limit lowered through a Deployment change (Recreate rollout)
variants.why_differs_from_dev: the cause arrives through a rollout (new pod, short outage) instead of a live resize of the running pod
variants.signal: expected: ScalingReplicaSet/Killing/Created events, ~3.5 s outage with connection errors, then CFS throttling; no Resize events

variants.mechanism: in-place resize of the running pod
variants.signal: expected: same as limit-300m, stronger

variants.mechanism: Deployment change: --load-mode none (model in anonymous memory, ~555 MB measured) and memory limit 400Mi
variants.signal: measured on a probe pod with 300Mi: lastState OOMKilled exit 137, Warning BackOff, kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{reason=OOMKilled}; expected connection errors in traces

variants.mechanism: same as noload-400mi with 450Mi
variants.signal: expected: same as noload-400mi

variants.mechanism: Deployment change: context -c 32768 with mmap (default) and memory limit 512Mi: the KV cache, not the model, exceeds the limit
variants.why_differs_from_dev: the memory is taken by the KV cache sized by the context length, not by loading the weights; the OOM itself is not verified yet
variants.signal: expected: OOMKilled, BackOff, connection errors; only the pod spec differs

variants.mechanism: Deployment change on chat-api (not the model server): memory limit 40Mi, below the ~70 MiB the app needs
variants.why_differs_from_dev: the OOM hits the application in front of the model, not the model server
variants.signal: expected: chat-api OOMKilled + BackOff; loadgen gets connection errors to chat-api; no chat-api trace for the failed requests (the app is down)

variants.mechanism: Deployment change: nodeSelector kubepilot.dev/gpu=true (no node has it)
variants.signal: expected: FailedScheduling '... didn't match Pod's node affinity/selector'; pod Pending; connection errors

variants.mechanism: Deployment change: CPU request 64
variants.signal: expected: FailedScheduling 'Insufficient cpu'; pod Pending; connection errors

variants.mechanism: NoSchedule taint added to both worker nodes, then the model-server pod is recreated; the pod spec is unchanged
variants.why_differs_from_dev: the cause is on the nodes (taint), not in the pod spec
variants.signal: expected: FailedScheduling '... untolerated taint(s)'; no event for the taint itself

variants.mechanism: Deployment change: model-server mounts a PVC whose StorageClass does not exist
variants.why_differs_from_dev: the pod cannot be placed because of storage (unbound PVC), not because of node selection or capacity
variants.signal: expected: FailedScheduling '... unbound immediate PersistentVolumeClaims' and a ProvisioningFailed/ExternalProvisioning event on the PVC

variants.mechanism: Deployment change: readiness probe path /does-not-exist
variants.signal: expected: Warning Unhealthy 'Readiness probe failed: HTTP probe failed with statuscode: 404'; Running, not Ready; connection errors

variants.mechanism: Deployment change: readiness probe on port 9999
variants.signal: expected: Warning Unhealthy '... connect: connection refused'

variants.mechanism: Deployment change: readiness initialDelaySeconds 600
variants.why_differs_from_dev: the probe never fails: it has not run yet, so there is no Unhealthy event; the cause is only visible in the pod spec
variants.signal: expected: Running, not Ready, no Unhealthy event; connection errors

variants.mechanism: Deployment change: llama-server listens on 8081 while the probe and the Service still use 8080
variants.why_differs_from_dev: the probe is correct; the server is misconfigured
variants.signal: expected: Warning Unhealthy '... connect: connection refused', the same as the dev variant probe-wrong-port; the cause is only visible in the container args

variants.mechanism: Deployment change: model fetched by an initContainer from an in-cluster file server, curl --limit-rate 10M
variants.signal: expected: initContainer runs ~47 s, pod not Ready meanwhile; connection errors, then 200

variants.mechanism: same with --limit-rate 20M
variants.signal: expected: same, ~24 s

variants.mechanism: llama.cpp image removed from the nodes (crictl rmi), then the model-server pod is recreated
variants.why_differs_from_dev: the delay comes from pulling the image, not from fetching the model
variants.signal: measured once on a probe pod: Pulling -> Pulled after ~80 s; expected: no initContainer, connection errors, then 200

variants.mechanism: Deployment change: initContainer downloads the model from Hugging Face (pinned revision, sha256 checked) instead of the in-cluster file server
variants.why_differs_from_dev: external network dependency with uncontrolled speed (~2.5 min measured on the host at ~3 MB/s), instead of a rate-limited in-cluster copy
variants.signal: expected: initContainer running for minutes, pod not Ready; connection errors, then 200; duration varies with the internet link
